name: ARCTURUS DEFENSE Predator-7 IFF Combat Eye
product_name: Arcturus Defense Solutions Predator-7 IFF Combat Ocular
description:
The Predator-7 is a full ocular replacement housing a dual-spectrum sensor array capable of switching between visible light, thermal, and low-light modes in under 40 milliseconds. Its onboard ballistic processor runs continuous trajectory prediction overlays, IFF tagging via encrypted Arcturus combat-net handshake, and threat-priority ranking across up to 24 simultaneous targets. A micro-gyroscope compensates for host movement, keeping targeting reticles stable during full-sprint engagements.

Distributed exclusively through Arcturus Defense Solutions' licensed military and CorpSec channels, the Predator-7 is the standard-issue eye of GLMZ's private military contractors and Tier 4-5 security divisions. On the black market it commands a ferocious premium, and unauthorized units are hardware-locked with a firmware kill-switch that Arcturus can trigger remotely—a fact that hasn't stopped desperate Shelf runners from gambling on grey-market pulls.
installation_requirements: Full ocular socket surgery, encrypted Arcturus firmware key, licensed combat-net registration
rejection_risk: Moderate — titanium housing minimizes biological rejection but neural handshake calibration can cause persistent migraine episodes in ~18% of recipients
maintenance: Quarterly firmware patch via Arcturus service node; lens array cleaning every 6 weeks; gyroscope recalibration after heavy impact

cultural_context: The Predator-7 is the cyberware equivalent of a status symbol among CorpSec contractors — visible from across a room by its faint red iris-ring that glows under thermal load. On the Shelf, spotting one means either a very rich or very desperate person is nearby.
